verdict.rationale: Penpot's own marketing says it has native design tokens and lists a Design Tokens feature for aligning designers and developers, so the core capability exists first-party. The evidence never describes which token types it supports, how tokens are managed, or any modes or themes applied across designs. missing for 10: documentation of color/spacing/typography token types, token management workflow, modes/themes support and switching, application of tokens across files, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a designer, I can manage design tokens or variables — colors, spacing, typography — with modes or themes applied across designs

citations.quote: Open-source alternative with self-hosting, unlimited files, native design tokens.
Design Tokens - Make design decisions that align designers and developers' workflows.
connecting product logic, tokens, and implementation
